site: Heico ADP Preliminary Questions; form options across portals
class: Validation error text pollutes radio accessible names and blocks option matching
symptom: On ADP, an unanswered radio group presented options as ['Error Add response.', 'Error Add response.'] in the accessibility tree, causing option matching for 'Yes' or 'No' to fail and leaving the field unanswered.
root_cause: When a field is submitted blank, ADP's markup associates the validation error banner ('Error Add response.') with the radio buttons via aria-describedby/aria-errormessage, which overwrites their computed accessible name in the snapshot. parse_snapshot only adopted child/adjacent text if controls[-1].name was empty.
why_tests_missed: Existing snapshot tests used clean markup where radio buttons carried empty names or exact label names, not DOM trees mutated by live validation errors.
fix: In parse_snapshot, recognize validation error and placeholder phrases on radio/checkbox/switch controls (_CHOICE_ERROR_NAME) and allow child or adjacent generic/text elements (indent >= last_control_indent) to provide the genuine choice label.
prevention: Never treat validation error banners as valid option choice labels. Ensure radio/checkbox parsers recover the actual choice text from child or sibling DOM nodes when errors are present.
